text: OddsFront explains geopolitical developments alongside related prediction markets. Reports lead with verified news; market probabilities are a separate, continuously refreshed layer.

The desk follows Reuters, Axios, Al Jazeera, The Kyiv Independent, BBC, The Guardian, Euronews, Sky News, Meduza and TV Rain. Original reporting draws on independent media and relevant primary institutional evidence. Each article links to its sources and preserves their publication dates.

Automated research and editorial checks reject unsupported claims, duplicate stories and copied wording. The desk never fills a missing fact with invented news, quotations or market odds. Publication is scheduled every two hours; an incomplete edition remains private until ten verified stories are ready.

English is the original editorial language. Local machine translation provides Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French, Russian, Ukrainian, Persian and Hebrew editions without paid translation APIs. Translated articles link to the original; source names and citations stay intact.

Related event cards use the same public market feed as the OddsFront map. Track opens DropsBot; View market opens the official market. An empty panel means no suitable active market is available. A credited partner cover is shown when its source page supplies one; OddsFront geographic artwork remains the fallback.
